summary: Một inference engine cao tốc cho các mô hình AI, tối ưu hóa tốc độ chạy LLM và TTS trên nền tảng Rust và Metal.
usecases: Deploy large language models locally on edge devices with low latency
Enable offline TTS and voice assistant functionality without cloud dependency
Accelerate AI inference for enterprise applications on CPU/GPU via Rust optimization
ideas: Combine with WebGPU/WebAssembly to run AI inference directly in browsers
Build a fully offline personal AI assistant that handles chat, summarization, and generation
Create a real-time audio modulation tool for gaming or creative production using TTS/LLM
